    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0

        return scores
    is_empty = (bins == bins[0]) & (rem == bins[0] - item) 
    tightness = 1.0 / (1.0 + rem)

    empty_indices = np.where(fit & (bins == np.max(bins)))[0]
    if len(empty_indices) > 0 and np.all(rem[fit] > 0.5 * bins[fit]):

    else:
        scores[fit & (rem == np.max(bins))] *= 0.5

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.where(rem >= 0, rem, -np.inf)
    empty_mask = (bins == np.max(bins)) & (rem >= 0)
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        scores = np.where(empty_mask, np.max(bins) - rem + 1.0, scores)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    initial_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    fill_ratio = 1.0 - (rem[valid] / (initial_cap + 1e-8))
    base_score = np.exp(fill_ratio) - (rem[valid] / (initial_cap + 1e-8))
    is_empty = (bins[valid] == initial_cap)
    bonus = np.where(is_empty, 0.5, 0.0)
    scores[valid] = base_score + bonus
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full(bins.shape, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    if max_cap == 0:
        max_cap = 1.0
    fit_score = np.exp(-rem[valid])
    capacity_bias = bins[valid] / max_cap
    scores[valid] = fit_score + 0.1 * capacity_bias
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    priorities = np.full(bins.shape, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return priorities
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    fit_penalty = np.exp(-rem[valid])
    capacity_proportion = bins[valid] / (1.0 + max_cap)
    priorities[valid] = fit_penalty * 2.0 + capacity_proportion * 2.0
    return priorities
